features.semantics: Adds a named proof hypothesis to generated verification obligations. It does not change the program function's parameter list or runtime arity.
features.obligations: No standalone obligation; the proposition is a hypothesis for assertions and postconditions.
diagnostics: requires must be named in ps3-pure-contracts0
result is not valid in requires
requires names must not collide with function parameters

features.semantics: Generates one postcondition proof obligation under the function parameters and all requires hypotheses.
features.obligations: One stable ensures obligation per clause.
diagnostics: ensures names must be unique so obligation IDs remain unambiguous

features.semantics: Rewrites to an application of the contracted function to program parameters only. Requires hypotheses are theorem assumptions and are never passed as function arguments.
features.obligations: Participates in the enclosing ensures obligation.
diagnostics: result is reserved as a contract parameter name
result is rejected in the runtime body

features.semantics: Introduces a named proof obligation at the assertion point under the function parameters and requires hypotheses.
features.obligations: One stable assert obligation per assertion.
features.runtime: proof-only and removed from the extracted contract runtime body; erasure alone is not a runtime-correctness proof
diagnostics: result is not valid in assert

features.semantics: Defines a nonrecursive logical abbreviation. Ghost references in requires/ensures/assert propositions are substituted by the ghost expression before proof obligations are emitted.
features.obligations: No standalone obligation; ghost substitutions affect enclosing proof obligations.
features.runtime: erased; any reference from extracted runtime code is rejected. This is a syntactic non-interference check, not a formal backend erasure proof.
diagnostics: ghost names must not collide with result, parameters, or requires hypotheses
ghost expressions may not depend on result
ghost expressions are nonrecursive and may not depend on ghost names in ps3-pure-contracts0
